translations.en: Sa'd ibn Muslim - the one who narrated the book 'Verily We have caused it to descend' from 'Umar ibn Tawba -

en.summary: This entry from al-Ghada'iri's *Kitab al-Du'afa* identifies Sa'd ibn Muslim as a transmitter of the specific work 'Kitab Inna Anzalnahu' from 'Uar ibn Tawba, yet classifies him as 'not recognized' (la yu'raf). In Shia hadith criticism, this designation typically implies that while he may be a reliable narrator, he lacks the widespread fame or distinct biographical details required for high-level authentication, often rendering his individual narrations weak or requiring corroboration.
en.seo_question: Who is Sa'd ibn Muslim and what is his status in Shia hadith sciences?

key_terms.سَعْدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ: Sa'd ibn Muslim, the narrator being evaluated
key_terms.عُمَرَ بْنِ تَابَةَ: 'Umar ibn Tawba, the source from whom Sa'd narrated
key_terms.لَا يُعْرَفُ: He is not recognized, a technical term indicating an unknown or weak narrator
key_terms.إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَاهُ: Verily We have caused it to descend, a reference to the opening of Surah Al-Baqarah, used here to identify a specific book or collection
